required_packages <- c("tidyverse", "lubridate", "scales", "ggtext",
                        "patchwork", "gt", "gtExtras", "showtext")
installed <- rownames(installed.packages())
to_install <- required_packages[!required_packages %in% installed]
if (length(to_install)) install.packages(to_install)

library(tidyverse)

## ✔ forcats   1.0.1     ✔ stringr   1.5.2

library(lubridate)
library(scales)
##

## The following object is masked from 'package:purrr':
##

library(ggtext)
library(patchwork)
library(gt)
library(gtExtras)
library(showtext)
## Loading required package: sysfonts
## Loading required package: showtextdb
# UCSB brand palette
ucsb_blue   <- "#003660"
ucsb_gold   <- "#FEBC11"
ucsb_navy   <- "#002542"
ucsb_light  <- "#9CBEBE"
ucsb_grey   <- "#BBC8CB"

theme_ucsb <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(color = ucsb_blue, face = "bold", size = 15),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 11),
      plot.caption     = element_text(color = "grey55", size = 9),
      axis.title       = element_text(color = ucsb_navy),
      axis.text        = element_text(color = "grey30"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90"),
      legend.position  = "bottom",
      strip.text       = element_text(color = ucsb_blue, face = "bold")
    )
}
posts <- read_csv("posts_clean (1).csv") |>
  mutate(
    Time_Posted      = ymd_hms(Time_Posted),
    Date             = as.Date(Date),
    Media_Type       = str_to_title(Media_Type),
    DayOfWeek        = factor(DayOfWeek, levels = c("Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday",
                                                       "Thursday","Friday","Saturday","Sunday")),
    Month            = factor(Month, levels = c("January","February","March"))
  )
## Rows: 67 Columns: 19
## ── Column specification ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Delimiter: ","
## chr   (4): Media_Type, Month, DayOfWeek, Caption_Short
## dbl  (13): Engagement_Rate_Pct, Engagements, Followers, Views, Reach, Likes,...
## dttm  (1): Time_Posted
## date  (1): Date
## 
## ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data.
## ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.
reels <- read_csv("reels_clean (1).csv") |>
  mutate(
    Time_Posted = ymd_hms(Time_Posted),
    Date        = as.Date(Date),
    DayOfWeek   = factor(DayOfWeek, levels = c("Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday",
                                                 "Thursday","Friday","Saturday","Sunday")),
    Month       = factor(Month, levels = c("January","February","March"))
  )
## Rows: 22 Columns: 21
## ── Column specification ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Delimiter: ","
## chr   (5): Media_Type, Product_Type, Month, DayOfWeek, Caption_Short
## dbl  (14): Engagement_Rate_Pct, Engagements, Comments, Likes, Views, Saves, ...
## dttm  (1): Time_Posted
## date  (1): Date
## 
## ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data.
## ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.
demo <- read_csv("demographics_clean.csv")
## Rows: 21 Columns: 4
## ── Column specification ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Delimiter: ","
## chr (2): Gender, Age_Group
## dbl (2): Total, Percentage
## 
## ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data.
## ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.
cat("\n===== POST PERFORMANCE SUMMARY =====\n")
## 
## ===== POST PERFORMANCE SUMMARY =====
posts |>
  summarise(
    n_posts         = n(),
    avg_eng_rate    = mean(Engagement_Rate_Pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_reach       = mean(Reach, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_views       = mean(Views, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_likes     = sum(Likes, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_shares    = sum(Shares, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_saves     = sum(Saves, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |> print()
## # A tibble: 1 × 7
##   n_posts avg_eng_rate avg_reach avg_views total_likes total_shares total_saves
##     <int>        <dbl>     <dbl>     <dbl>       <dbl>        <dbl>       <dbl>
## 1      67         3.65     4026.     9823.        8623         1431         272
cat("\n===== REEL PERFORMANCE SUMMARY =====\n")
## 
## ===== REEL PERFORMANCE SUMMARY =====
reels |>
  summarise(
    n_reels         = n(),
    avg_eng_rate    = mean(Engagement_Rate_Pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_skip_rate   = mean(Skip_Rate_Pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_reach       = mean(Reach, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_views       = mean(Views, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_likes     = sum(Likes, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_shares    = sum(Shares, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |> print()
## # A tibble: 1 × 7
##   n_reels avg_eng_rate avg_skip_rate avg_reach avg_views total_likes
##     <int>        <dbl>         <dbl>     <dbl>     <dbl>       <dbl>
## 1      22         2.88          54.9     5040.     9354.        2838
## # ℹ 1 more variable: total_shares <dbl>
#  Weekly Reach & Engagement Over Time ───────────────────────────
weekly_posts <- posts |>
  group_by(Week) |>
  summarise(
    Total_Reach       = sum(Reach, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Engagements = sum(Engagements, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_Eng_Rate      = mean(Engagement_Rate_Pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_posts           = n()
  )

p_weekly <- ggplot(weekly_posts, aes(x = Week)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = Total_Reach), fill = ucsb_light, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Total_Engagements * 10), color = ucsb_blue, linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(aes(y = Total_Engagements * 10), color = ucsb_gold, size = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name     = "Total Reach",
    labels   = comma,
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / 10, name = "Total Engagements", labels = comma)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(weekly_posts$Week)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Weekly Reach & Engagements — Winter Quarter 2026",
    subtitle = "Bars = Reach  |  Line = Engagements",
    x        = "Week of Quarter",
    caption  = "Source: UCSB Rec Instagram Analytics"
  ) +
  theme_ucsb()

print(p_weekly)

#  Engagement Rate by Media Type ──────────────────────────────────
p_media <- posts |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Media_Type, y = Engagement_Rate_Pct, fill = Media_Type)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.4, color = "white") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = 21, outlier.size = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(ucsb_blue, ucsb_gold, ucsb_light)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  labs(
    title    = "Engagement Rate Distribution by Media Type",
    subtitle = "Winter Quarter 2026  |  67 posts",
    x        = NULL, y = "Engagement Rate",
    caption  = "Source: UCSB Rec Instagram Analytics"
  ) +
  theme_ucsb() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

print(p_media)

#  Best Day & Hour to Post (Heatmap) ─────────────────────────────
day_hour <- posts |>
  mutate(Hour_Bin = cut(Hour, breaks = c(0, 8, 12, 15, 18, 24),
                        labels = c("Pre-8am","8–11am","12–2pm","3–5pm","6pm+"))) |>
  group_by(DayOfWeek, Hour_Bin) |>
  summarise(Avg_Reach = mean(Reach, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

p_heatmap <- ggplot(day_hour, aes(x = Hour_Bin, y = fct_rev(DayOfWeek), fill = Avg_Reach)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = comma(round(Avg_Reach))), size = 3, color = "white", fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = ucsb_light, high = ucsb_blue, labels = comma) +
  labs(
    title    = "Average Reach by Day & Posting Window",
    subtitle = "Darker = Higher Reach",
    x        = "Time of Day", y = NULL,
    fill     = "Avg Reach",
    caption  = "Source: UCSB Rec Instagram Analytics"
  ) +
  theme_ucsb() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

print(p_heatmap)

# ─ Reel Skip Rate vs. Engagement ─────────────────────────────────
p_reel_skip <- reels |>
  filter(!is.na(Skip_Rate_Pct)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Skip_Rate_Pct, y = Engagement_Rate_Pct)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = ucsb_light, fill = ucsb_grey, alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_point(aes(size = Views, color = Views), alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = ucsb_gold, high = ucsb_blue, labels = comma) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 10), labels = comma) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  labs(
    title    = "Reel Skip Rate vs. Engagement Rate",
    subtitle = "Point size & color = Views",
    x        = "Skip Rate", y = "Engagement Rate",
    color    = "Views", size = "Views",
    caption  = "Source: UCSB Rec Instagram Analytics"
  ) +
  theme_ucsb()

print(p_reel_skip)
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'

# Plot E: Audience Demographics ─────────────────────────────────────────
p_demo_age <- demo |>
  filter(Age_Group != "Total") |>   # exclude the totals row
  ggplot(aes(x = Age_Group, y = Percentage, fill = Gender)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(ucsb_blue, ucsb_gold, ucsb_light)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  labs(
    title    = "Audience Age & Gender Distribution",
    subtitle = "Winter Quarter 2026",
    x        = "Age Group", y = "% of Audience",
    fill     = "Gender",
    caption  = "Source: UCSB Rec Instagram Analytics"
  ) +
  theme_ucsb()

print(p_demo_age)

# Top 10 Posts by Engagement Rate ───────────────────────────────
top10_posts <- posts |>
  arrange(desc(Engagement_Rate_Pct)) |>
  head(10) |>
  mutate(Label = str_wrap(str_trunc(Caption_Short, 45), 40))

p_top10 <- ggplot(top10_posts,
                  aes(x = Engagement_Rate_Pct,
                      y = reorder(Label, Engagement_Rate_Pct),
                      fill = Media_Type)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(Engagement_Rate_Pct, "%")),
            hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5, color = ucsb_navy) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(ucsb_blue, ucsb_gold, ucsb_light)) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15)),
                     labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  labs(
    title    = "Top 10 Posts by Engagement Rate",
    subtitle = "Winter Quarter 2026",
    x        = "Engagement Rate", y = NULL,
    fill     = "Media Type",
    caption  = "Source: UCSB Rec Instagram Analytics"
  ) +
  theme_ucsb()

print(p_top10)

# ── 9. Combined Dashboard (patchwork) ─────────────────────────────────────────
dashboard <- (p_weekly | p_media) /
             (p_heatmap | p_reel_skip) /
             (p_demo_age | p_top10) +
  plot_annotation(
    title   = "UCSB Department of Recreation — Instagram Analytics Dashboard",
    subtitle = "Winter Quarter 2026  |  Jan 5 – Mar 21",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(color = ucsb_blue, face = "bold", size = 18),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 13)
    )
  )

ggsave("ucsb_rec_winter_dashboard.png", dashboard, width = 18, height = 20,
       dpi = 180, bg = "white")
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'
cat("\nDashboard saved to ucsb_rec_winter_dashboard.png\n")
## 
## Dashboard saved to ucsb_rec_winter_dashboard.png
